Damian Paletta
 
Trump’s $5,000 ‘Dividend’ Promise Is His Biggest Election Gambit Yet
 
The pledge is to every American adult citizen if the Republicans retain control of the House and Senate in the midterms
 
 
JABIN BOTSFORD FOR WSJ
 

Good evening from Dallas. President Trump on Wednesday night unleashed perhaps his biggest election-year promise to date.

 

He vowed a $5,000 “dividend” payment to every American adult citizen if Republicans retain control of the House and the Senate in the November midterms. 

 

This could be more than 200 million payments.

 

He’s essentially promising more than $1 trillion in these “dividends” unless income limit restrictions were put in place.

 

Where would the money come from? He hinted it could come from tariff revenue, though that wasn’t completely clear. 

 

And how could this be done in a way that didn’t cause a spike in inflation? That will largely fuel a huge debate.

 

Would Republicans in Congress go along with this? Trump didn’t say, though if he helped them salvage their majorities in these midterms, it might be hard for them to say no.

 

Offering money (or benefits) to voters is a tried and true political tactic. And Trump has in the past floated these sorts of populist payments (though none quite this big) to Americans. 

 

There were the $1,200 stimulus checks that went out in 2020, during the Covid outbreak (the Trump administration put the president’s name on the checks that went out to many Americans, something President Joe Biden would later say was a smart tactic). There were income limits on these checks, though, to prevent wealthier Americans from receiving them.

 

Congress later in 2020 approved an additional $600 “stimulus” payment, after Trump lost re-election. Trump at the time said the stimulus payments should have been $2,000.

 

And last year, Trump promised Americans a $2,000 tariff “dividend,” though this never happened. 

 

Here’s what Trump said Wednesday night: “If the Republicans win the House of Representatives and the United States Senate, both of them, because of our economic—tremendous economic success—like in history we’ve never had anything like what’s happening, but because of our tremendous strength and success economically, I will issue a dividend to every adult citizen in the United States of America for $5,000.”
